name: Fables
description: A dynamic-fee ve(3,3) DEX built on Uniswap v4. Each pool charges a fee tuned to its asset — calendar-based for tokenised stocks, volatility-based for crypto — so LPs are paid more when a trade is more likely to be against them.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders at the dynamic fee carried in each Swap event.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders at the dynamic fee carried in each Swap event, plus any fee FablesBribes takes from bribes (0% so far).
methodology.Revenue: From the ve(3,3) launch on 2026-10-20: swap fees earned by liquidity staked in gauges (booked as they accrue) and the 10% claim fee taken from unstaked ledger liquidity (booked when the ledger skims it), paid to veFABLES voters or to the treasury. Not broken out before the launch (reported as 0), when the claim fee went to the treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: From 2026-10-20: the claim fee taken from unstaked ledger liquidity in pools without a gauge or without votes, and on hooks whose claim-fee recipient is a treasury Safe, plus the fees of emergency-killed gauges and any bribe fee. Vote-churn penalties are not included.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: From 2026-10-20: swap fees earned by liquidity staked in a gauge that has votes and the claim fee taken from unstaked liquidity in those pools, paid to the pool's veFABLES voters, plus bribes from other parties forwarded to those voters (bribes paid by the Fables team excluded).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees kept by liquidity providers: from 2026-10-20, unstaked ledger LPs after the claim fee, LPs holding plain Uniswap v4 positions in Fables pools, and stakers refunded when their gauge has no votes; before it, every swap fee.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume across every Fables pool, enumerated from the on-chain FablesPoolRegistry and read from the Uniswap v4 PoolManager Swap logs, counted on the native or core-asset leg.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Dynamic swap fees paid by traders, taken from each Uniswap v4 Swap event.
Fees.Bribe Fees: The cut FablesBribes takes from bribes when they are forwarded to voters (0% so far).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Dynamic swap fees paid by traders, taken from each Uniswap v4 Swap event.

Revenue.Staked LP Fees To Voters: Swap fees earned by ledger shares staked in a gauge that has votes, booked as they accrue and paid to that gauge's veFABLES voters.
Revenue.Claim Fees To Voters: The claim fee (10%) taken from unstaked ledger liquidity in pools whose gauge has votes, forwarded to the epoch distributor for the voters.
Revenue.Claim Fees To Treasury: The claim fee taken from unstaked ledger liquidity paid to the treasury: pools without a gauge or without votes, and hooks whose claim-fee recipient is a treasury Safe.
Revenue.Killed Gauge Fees To Treasury: Fees of liquidity staked in an emergency-killed gauge, and its claim fee, paid to the treasury for that epoch.
Revenue.Bribe Fees To Treasury: The protocol cut taken from bribes when they are forwarded to voters (0% so far).

HoldersRevenue.Staked LP Fees To Voters: Swap fees earned by ledger shares staked in a gauge that has votes, booked as they accrue and paid to that gauge's veFABLES voters.
HoldersRevenue.Claim Fees To Voters: The claim fee (10%) taken from unstaked ledger liquidity in pools whose gauge has votes, forwarded to the epoch distributor for the voters.
HoldersRevenue.Bribes To Voters: Bribes other parties post on FablesBribes for a pool's veFABLES voters, counted when forwarded to the voters' distributor, net of any bribe fee. Bribes paid from Fables team Safes are excluded.

ProtocolRevenue.Claim Fees To Treasury: The claim fee taken from unstaked ledger liquidity paid to the treasury: pools without a gauge or without votes, and hooks whose claim-fee recipient is a treasury Safe.
ProtocolRevenue.Killed Gauge Fees To Treasury: Fees of liquidity staked in an emergency-killed gauge, and its claim fee, paid to the treasury for that epoch.
ProtocolRevenue.Bribe Fees To Treasury: The protocol cut taken from bribes when they are forwarded to voters (0% so far).

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: Swap fees kept by liquidity providers: unstaked ledger LPs after the claim fee, plain Uniswap v4 positions in Fables pools, and staked LPs refunded when their gauge has no votes (before 2026-10-20, every swap fee).
